q: What does QOL (Quality of Life) refer to?
si: පුද්ගලයෙකුගේ දෛනික ජීවිතයේ සහ ජීවිතයේ ගුණාත්මකභාවය.
options: The quality of a person's daily living and life
why: QOL concerns the quality of daily living and life, not one single physical or financial factor.

q: Which principle means allowing a person to make their own decisions?
ja: 自己決定（じこけってい）
si: පුද්ගලයාට තමන්ගේම තීරණ ගැනීමට ඉඩ දීම.
why: Self-determination means respecting the user's right to decide.

q: What is the core idea of normalization?
ja: ノーマライゼーション
si: හැකි තරම් සාමාන්‍ය සමාජ ජීවිතයක් ගත කිරීමට සහාය වීම.
options: Support a normal social life as much as possible
why: Normalization supports ordinary social life and participation.

q: Which is the correct care-process order?
ja: 介護過程（かいごかてい）
si: ඇගයීම → සත්කාර සැලැස්ම → ක්‍රියාත්මක කිරීම → ඇගයීම.
why: The master study note preserves this four-stage order.

q: Which action helps prevent lower-back injury during care work?
ja: 腰痛予防（ようつうよぼう）
si: පුළුල් support base එකක් තබා, center of gravity පහත් කර body mechanics භාවිතා කිරීම.
options: Use a wide base of support and lower the center of gravity
why: A stable base and efficient body mechanics reduce unnecessary load.

q: Which is an example of physical abuse?
ja: 身体的虐待（しんたいてきぎゃくたい）
si: ශාරීරික බලහත්කාරයෙන් හෝ හානි කිරීම.
why: Physical abuse involves harmful physical acts or force.

q: Why is privacy especially important during bathing and toileting?
si: ශරීරය නිරාවරණය විය හැකි නිසා ලජ්ජාව/අපහසුතාව අවම කිරීමට.
options: The user's body may be exposed
why: The user's dignity and privacy must be protected when the body is exposed.

q: A correct mask should cover which area?
si: නාසයේ සිට නිකටේ පහළ කොටස දක්වා මුහුණ ආවරණය කළ යුතුය.
options: From the nose to the bottom of the chin
why: The verified source specifies coverage from the nose to the bottom of the chin.

q: What should be done after removing disposable gloves?
ja: 使い捨て手袋（つかいすててぶくろ）
si: අත් සනීපාරක්ෂාව කළ යුතු අතර gloves නැවත භාවිතා නොකළ යුතුය.
options: Put them back in the box
why: Disposable gloves are single-use and hand hygiene is required after removal.

q: What is risk management concerned with?
si: අනතුරු/අවදානම් හඳුනාගෙන වැළැක්වීම හා පාලනය කිරීම.
why: Risk management focuses on identifying hazards and preventing harm.

q: Which system maintains internal balance in the body?
si: ශරීරයේ අභ්‍යන්තර සමතුලිතතාව පවත්වා ගැනීම.
why: Homeostasis is the body's regulation of its internal environment.

q: Which autonomic nervous system is associated with rest and digestion?
ja: 副交感神経（ふくこうかんしんけい）
si: විවේකය සහ ජීර්ණය සමඟ සම්බන්ධ වන්නේ parasympathetic system එකයි.
why: Parasympathetic activity supports rest and digestive functions.

q: Which response is associated with sympathetic activation?
ja: 交感神経（こうかんしんけい）
si: කනස්සල්ල, කෝපය, stress වැනි අවස්ථාවල sympathetic activity වැඩි විය හැක.
why: The study material associates sympathetic activity with arousal/stress states.

q: What is the basic urinary-system route?
ja: 腎臓 → 尿管 → 膀胱 → 尿道
si: වකුගඩුව → ureter → bladder → urethra.
why: This is the source-verified basic route.

q: What is a common concern with dehydration in a person needing care?
si: දියර අඩුවීම හඳුනාගෙන fluids අවශ්‍යතාව සලකා බැලීම වැදගත්ය.
why: Dehydration means insufficient body fluid.

q: Which disease is listed as Alzheimer's-type dementia in the study material?
ja: アルツハイマー型認知症
si: Alzheimer වර්ගයේ dementia.
why: The source-reconciliation section explicitly retains Alzheimer's-type dementia as an exam recognition point.

q: Which is a component of the ICF framework?
si: Body functions/structures, activities, participation සහ environmental/personal factors.
why: Activities are one of the ICF components presented in the study material.

q: What does 傾聴 mean in communication?
si: අනෙක් පුද්ගලයාගේ කතාව අවධානයෙන් අසා ගැනීම.
why: 傾聴 is attentive listening.

q: When communicating with a person with visual impairment, what is useful?
ja: 視覚障害（しかくしょうがい）
si: පරිසරය සහ ආහාර/භාණ්ඩ පිහිටීම clock position වැනි ක්‍රමයකින් පැහැදිලි කිරීම.
options: Explain locations clearly, including clock positions when useful
Move objects without telling the user
why: The material uses clock positions and advance explanation for visual impairment.

q: What is an appropriate response when a person with dementia expresses anxiety?
si: ඔහුගේ/ඇයගේ anxiety පිළිගෙන, ආරක්ෂිතව සවන් දී සහාය වීම.
options: Accept and respond to the person's anxiety
Argue that the feeling is wrong
why: The exam-note theme is to accept the person's anxious experience rather than dismiss it.

q: What should a nursing-care record prioritize?
si: එදිනම නිවැරදි date/time සමඟ facts ලෙස සටහන් කිරීම.
why: Records should be timely, accurate and factual.

q: What does Senuki help reduce during repositioning?
si: ඝර්ෂණය/පීඩනය අඩු කර pressure-ulcer අවදානම අඩු කිරීමට උපකාරී වේ.
why: Senuki reduces friction/pressure during movement and repositioning.

q: For stairs, where should the caregiver stand when the user goes up?
si: පසුපසින්, userට එක පියවරක් පහළින් සිටීම.
options: Behind the user, one step below
why: The study material preserves this safety position for going up stairs.

q: When should a wheelchair brake be activated?
si: wheelchair එක නවතා ඇති සෑම අවස්ථාවකම brake යෙදිය යුතුය.
why: The source note emphasizes activating the brake whenever the wheelchair is stopped.

q: During wheelchair movement, what must be protected from the driving wheel?
si: userගේ අත් driving wheel එකට අහුවීම වැළැක්විය යුතුය.
why: Hands must not be caught in the driving wheel.

q: For a steep downward wheelchair slope, which action is included?
si: userට පැහැදිලි කර wheelchair එක පසුපසට මුහුණලා ගෙන යාම.
options: Move backward after explaining to the user
why: The source procedure specifies backward movement on a steep downward slope.

q: What is the correct swallowing sequence?
si: 先行期 → 準備期 → 口腔期 → 咽頭期 → 食道期.
why: The five-stage swallowing sequence is source-verified.

q: What is an important mealtime posture?
ja: 食事姿勢（しょくじしせい）
si: පිටුපසට support, පාද floor මත, මදක් ඉදිරියට lean, chin tucked.
options: Supported back, feet on floor, slight forward lean, chin tucked
why: The source warns that raising the chin increases aspiration risk.

q: For a user with visual impairment, how can food location be explained?
ja: 時計の位置（とけいのいち）
si: plate එකේ ආහාර/භාණ්ඩ පිහිටීම clock position මඟින් පැහැදිලි කළ හැක.
why: Clock-position explanation is a source-verified technique.

q: What is the normal daily urine volume in the study material?
why: The final elimination page gives 1000–1500 mL per day.

q: What does polyuria refer to?
si: මුත්‍රා ප්‍රමාණය වැඩි වීම.
why: Polyuria is a volume increase; do not confuse it with pollakiuria.

q: What does pollakiuria refer to?
si: මුත්‍රා කිරීමේ වාර ගණන වැඩි වීම.
why: Pollakiuria concerns frequency, not total urine volume.

q: Which type of urinary incontinence is associated with coughing?
ja: 腹圧性尿失禁（ふくあつせいにょうしっきん）
si: කැස්සීමේදී leak වීම stress urinary incontinence සඳහා උදාහරණයකි.
why: The user's exam-note theme explicitly identifies leakage due to coughing as stress urinary incontinence.

q: What posture helps defecation by straightening the rectum-to-anus route?
ja: 排便姿勢（はいべんしせい）
si: ඉදිරියට lean වී heels ඉහළට තැබීම උපකාරී වේ.
options: Lean forward and raise the heels
why: This posture helps straighten the anorectal angle.

q: What is the correct hemiplegia dressing principle?
ja: 脱健着患（だっけんちゃくかん）
si: ඇඳුම් ඉවත් කිරීමේදී unaffected side පළමුව; ඇඳීමේදී affected side පළමුව.
options: Undress unaffected first; dress affected first
Undress affected first; dress unaffected first
why: 脱健着患 is the preserved dressing sequence.

q: When is nail clipping recommended in the study material?
si: නානෙන් පසු නිය මෘදු වූ අවස්ථාව භාවිතා කළ හැක.
why: The exam-note topic specifically highlights nail clipping after bathing.

q: Where are apocrine glands highlighted in the study material?
si: කිහිලි/underarms ප්‍රදේශය.
why: The user's exam-note theme identifies the armpits for apocrine glands.

q: Why is oral care important?
ja: 口腔ケア（こうくうケア）
si: දත්/මුඛ සෞඛ්‍යය පවත්වා ගැනීමට සහ aspiration pneumonia අවදානම අඩු කිරීමට උපකාරී වේ.
options: It helps oral health and reduces aspiration-pneumonia risk
It removes the need for dentures
why: The study material connects oral care with oral cleanliness and aspiration-pneumonia prevention.

q: Why should dressing-room and bathroom temperature differences be reduced?
si: හදිසි උෂ්ණත්ව වෙනස්කම් නිසා heat shock අවදානම අඩු කිරීමට.
why: The bathing-environment section links temperature differences with heat-shock risk.

q: Which is correct for washing hair?
si: finger pads/balls of fingers භාවිතා කර සෝදන්න; fingernails භාවිතා නොකරන්න.
options: Wash with the pads/balls of the fingers
why: The source specifically emphasizes using the pads/balls of the fingers.

q: In female genital cleaning, which direction is used?
ja: 陰部洗浄（いんぶせんじょう）
si: ඉදිරිපස සිට පසුපසට — urethra → anus.
why: Front-to-back cleaning reduces contamination risk.

q: What should be done with wet skin folds after bathing?
ja: 清潔保持（せいけつほじ）
si: skin folds හොඳින් වියළා, අවශ්‍ය නම් moisturize කරන්න.
why: Drying skin folds helps prevent moisture-related problems.

q: Housework is mainly classified under which daily-living category?
si: Housework IADL හි කොටසකි.
why: The housework chapter treats cooking, cleaning and related tasks as IADL.

q: What is the correct cooking sequence?
si: menu තීරණය → ingredients සූදානම් → cook → plate → table set → wash/put away.
options: Decide menu → prepare ingredients → cook → plate → set table → wash/put away
Wash dishes → cook → decide menu → plate
Cook → discard all food → set table
why: This exact sequence is source-verified in the housework chapter.

q: What should be considered when choosing food for a user?
si: ශාරීරික තත්ත්වය, රෝග, allergies සහ පුද්ගලික/සංස්කෘතික ආහාර පුරුදු සලකා බලන්න.
options: Physical condition, diseases, allergies and preferences
why: The source explicitly includes these factors in meal planning.

q: What is disuse syndrome?
ja: 廃用症候群（はいようしょうこうぐん）
si: දිගුකාලීන inactivity/bed rest නිසා ඇතිවන තත්ත්වයන් සමූහයකි.
options: Problems associated with prolonged inactivity or bed rest
why: The mobility chapter defines disuse syndrome in relation to long-term inactivity/bed rest.

q: Why is a quad cane more stable than a narrow-base cane?
si: base of support එක පුළුල් බැවින් වැඩි stability ලැබේ.
options: It has a wider base of support
It has no contact with the floor
It removes the need for balance
why: The study material distinguishes devices by their support base and stability.

q: How long should the user remain sitting after a meal according to the meal-assistance procedure?
ja: 誤嚥性肺炎予防（ごえんせいはいえんよぼう）
si: aspiration pneumonia වැළැක්වීමට ආහාරයෙන් පසු මිනිත්තු 30ක් පමණ sitting පවත්වා ගන්න.
why: The source procedure includes maintaining sitting for about 30 minutes after the meal.

q: What is the normal daily frequency of defecation given in the study material?
si: සාමාන්‍යයෙන් දිනකට 1–2 වාර ලෙස දක්වා ඇත.
why: The elimination section gives 1–2 times per day as the normal stool frequency reference.

q: What is the correct complete bed-bath order?
si: මුහුණ → අත් → chest/abdomen → back → legs → genital area.
options: Face → arms → chest/abdomen → back → legs → genital area
Genital area → face → back → arms → legs
Back → face → genital area → chest → arms
why: The final study sheet preserves this complete bed-bath sequence.
